transnational corporations should be encouraged to take the social responsibilities of the host countries as their own,so as to make a contribution to the economic development and social stability of the host countries,which would also help to improve the image of the transnational corporations themselves.

, in order to ensure the result that transnational corporations can benefit from China and China can benefit from transnational corporations, the following countermeasures are needed: First of all, the Chinese government should improve its legal system and strengthen its legal supervision over the transnational corporations.

the weakening in the social responsibility of transnational corporations in China is not a result of the transnational corporations' own intention,but a result of the lack of effective supervision by the Chinese government and a result of the Chinese government's lack of understanding of transnational corporations' social responsibility.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the weakening of social responsibilities of transnational corporations in China should not be overemphasized,for it is a natural result of economic development,which is inevitable and even necessary for China's economic growth.

transnational corporations should be more active and responsible in their social responsibilities,which will be good not only for the development of the enterprises but also for the development of China's economy.

the government of China should strengthen its supervision and regulation over the transnational corporations in China,while the transnational corporations themselves should also improve their management of social responsibilities in China.
The main takeaway from our work is that

transnational corporations are playing a very important role in the process of globalization,they have brought great contribution to the economic and social development of China,however,they are also facing some new challenges in China,including the weakening of some areas of their social responsibilities.

transnational corporations should take more social responsibilities,especially in product quality and labor relationship,so as to ensure a win-win situation in the process of China's opening and reform.
